title: Wands in tarot: court card meanings
description: Page, Knight, Queen and King of Wands in tarot: upright and reversed meanings, and how to read court cards as people, parts of yourself or approaches.

scenes.headline: Wands in tarot: court card meanings
scenes.caption: The Page, Knight, Queen and King of Wands bring the energy of fire to a tarot spread. Court cards can be people, parts of yourself or ways of approaching a situation.
scenes.vo: The Page, Knight, Queen and King of Wands bring the energy of fire to a tarot spread. Court cards can be people, parts of yourself or ways of approaching a situation.

scenes.headline: Page of Wands
scenes.caption: Curiosity, enthusiasm, new ideas. The Page stands in a desert landscape and looks closely at the wand held in one hand.

scenes.headline: Knight of Wands
scenes.caption: Passion, speed, adventure. The Knight rides a rearing horse, armour covered with a pattern, wand held high.
